# WavSampleFormat

[DotGame.AudioCodecs](README.md) · `DotGame.AudioCodecs.Wav` · enum

public enum WavSampleFormat

How a WAV file stores its samples.

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="pcm8"></a>`Pcm8` | 8-bit integers, unsigned (as WAV stores 8 bits). |

| <a name="pcm24"></a>`Pcm24` | 24-bit integers. |
